_README: Per-industry STARTING POINTS for what the agent can answer about. Loaded into the Agent Builder's 'Product & company facts' and 'Questions customers actually ask' whenever the industry changes, and overwritten the moment a human edits either field. Written in plain speakable English because every line is read aloud: numbers as words, no codes or abbreviations the agent would spell out badly. These are GENERIC to the industry and must be checked against the real client before a live call, which is why the builder shows a warning above them. The hard boundary in the global prompt still applies whatever is written here: the agent never improvises certifications, safety or structural suitability, medical, legal or tax positions, or anything financially binding.
